title: Cherry Vanilla
description: Cherry Vanilla is a server focused on modern Minecraft versions with several game modes such as Semi-Anarchy, Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, Netherite POT, and much more.
body:
![Cherry Vanilla logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92d64b74090050b7cfce376d3438bc7cc9bd8660.png)

# THE BEST SEMI-ANARCHY AND PVP SERVER IN BRAZIL!

Cherry Vanilla is a fully Brazilian server dedicated to multiple PvP modes on modern Minecraft versions. Check out our game modes:

### FreeForAll
* Play Sword PvP, NetheritePOT, and MacePvP in a free arena.

### Sandbox
* Create any kit you want and fight other players automatically using /fq!
* Focused on Crystal PvP.

### Semi-Anarchy
* Our biggest mode on the server! Play with 80+ other players in a true semi-anarchy experience.
